documents.title: Edge Telemetry Gateway Failover
documents.text: Gateway GW-ZAHLE-01 aggregates Modbus TCP frames from Delta DVP-14SS2 PLCs and forwards MQTT payloads over TLS 1.3. When primary fiber link FIB-BEKAA-NORTH exceeds 15% packet loss, watchdog daemon net-guard triggers BGP failover to LTE modem MDM-77.

documents.title: Solar MPPT & LiFePO4 Power Bus
documents.text: Remote station POP-CHTOURA-02 runs on a 24V LiFePO4 battery bank charged by Victron SmartSolar MPPT 100/50. If bus voltage drops below 22.4V, load-shedding relay K3 disconnects auxiliary PoE cameras while preserving Gateway GW-ZAHLE-01 and MDM-77.

documents.title: YOLOv8 Conveyor Vision Node
documents.text: Raspberry Pi 4 node RPI4-SORT-01 executes quantized INT8 YOLOv8n inference at 28 FPS and sends RS-485 actuation pulses to Delta DVP-14SS2 register D100 to drive stepper gate DRV-TB6600.
